events.comment: PLINKO DUNGEON roguelike. Aiming stays in visual events; run, map, enemies, board generation and combat live in the JavaScript events below (shared namespace gdjs.PD, state in runtimeScene.__pd).
Aiming: keyboard and mouse move the dropper, clamped to the playfield.
Data: orbs, relics, enemies and acts
Procedural act map (branching paths, Slay-the-Spire style)
Battle: start, drop, peg hits and physics refinement
Battle: bucket payout, enemy turn, victory and defeat
Visual cleanup: spark FX and peg hit flashes.
